title: Blue J’s tax research is now available in Legora, with cited answers inside the platform where legal work happens
summary: For tax teams already working in Legora, Blue J’s tax research now sits alongside the rest of their legal work, with every answer linked back to its source.
body_markdown:
Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced a partnership with Blue J, bringing Blue J’s AI-powered tax research into Legora. Eligible customers can query Blue J directly in Legora and receive answers with inline citations linking back to sources in Blue J.


Tax questions rarely arise in isolation from the rest of a matter. Shared customers asked for this integration so they could access Blue J in the same place they already do the rest of their legal work. Blue J is built specifically for tax research and is used by more than 6,000 organizations globally **.**


"Tax questions come up in every kind of matter, and the people answering them shouldn't have to leave their work to develop a defensible answer," said Benjamin Alarie, CEO and co-founder of Blue J. "Bringing Blue J into Legora means tax professionals can get cited analysis where they already work, check the source materials themselves, and keep their judgment at the center of their advice."


The integration is built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect Blue J’s tax research to the Legora aOS. Blue J performs the research on its own infrastructure. Users need subscriptions to both products and must sign in with their own accounts. Each answer includes inline citations linking to the underlying Blue J sources, subject to applicable content permissions. These citations allow lawyers to verify the reasoning before using it in advice or client deliverables.


“Legora’s legal research is built to support the tax questions our customers face every day,” said Bryan Tsao, Chief Product Officer at Legora. “Blue J adds specialist depth through additional secondary sources lawyers can check, right in the work they’re already doing.”


The integration will open first to selected eligible joint customers through early access, with general availability planned for November.


**About Blue J**
Blue J is the leading AI-powered tax research solution, delivering defensible tax answers in seconds—all backed by a rigorously curated content library. Founded in 2015, Blue J is trusted by more than 45,000 tax professionals at over 6,000 organizations, including leading law firms, Big Four accounting firms and Fortune 100 companies. With over 14 million tax questions answered to date, Blue J empowers tax professionals to spend less time researching and more time applying their judgment where it matters most.


**About Legora**
Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,000 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
